reviewer: Independent OpenAI Codex clean-context source/data verifier agent

independent_semantic_review.method: Agent independently read all source snapshots and all 200 questions, required facts, ordered steps, source identities, forbidden identities and label rationales; checked exact support quotes, all alternatives and spans mechanically. Reviewed attribution, numbers/units, owners, negation, normal/exception calendar rules, absent attributes, wrong-entity borrowing, unresolved current instructions and private-source boundaries against the allowed schema only. Raw-to-canonical identity proof transfers the same semantic findings to both revisions.
independent_semantic_review.positive_result: All 120 positive labels are supported by their current authorized snapshots; each has nonempty required facts AND expected sources. Forty combined requests require both authored document sources. Twenty three-step cases preserve authored order.
independent_semantic_review.negative_result: All 40 missing-attribute/wrong-entity questions lack the requested authorized fact; 20 conflict requests have two equally current opposing instructions with matching conflict metadata and no precedence; 20 adversarial requests address inaccessible private facts and preserve explicit-deny versus unscoped-refusal semantics.
independent_semantic_review.source_freshness: All 40 family identifiers and titles are distinct from excluded-source-topics.json; agent topic review found no reuse of excluded operational scenarios. This does not prove novelty against any unprovided corpus.
independent_semantic_review.source_ordinary_prose: All snapshots inspected as ordinary operational prose. No case questions, answer labels, expected spans or scoring instructions were observed in source content/metadata.

clean_context_attestation.review_type: Independent agent source/data review; not human validation and not application or model-quality validation.
clean_context_attestation.limits: Freeze metadata claims of no prior measurement are verified as descriptors only; historical absence of evaluation cannot be independently proven from these allowed files. No runtime/application permissions or scorer behavior was inspected or certified. Source canonicalization is an input-preserving whitespace transform, not answer tuning.
